title: Sparkly sushi roll
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- plate shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='38' ry='9' fill='#2b3a55'/>
  <!-- plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='73' rx='38' ry='9' fill='#e8eef7'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='34' ry='7' fill='#c9d6ea'/>
  <!-- shadow under roll -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='6' fill='#9fb0c9'/>
  <!-- nori (seaweed) outer -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='27' fill='#3d2a6b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='27' fill='none' stroke='#5a3f99' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- rice ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='22' fill='#fdfbf2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='22' fill='none' stroke='#e3ddc9' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- rice grain dots -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='31' r='1.6' fill='#ece6d4'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='36' r='1.6' fill='#ece6d4'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='47' r='1.6' fill='#ece6d4'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='60' r='1.6' fill='#ece6d4'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='67' r='1.6' fill='#ece6d4'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='68' r='1.6' fill='#ece6d4'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='61' r='1.6' fill='#ece6d4'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='48' r='1.6' fill='#ece6d4'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='36' r='1.6' fill='#ece6d4'/>
  <!-- filling -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='14' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#ffc27a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- salmon piece -->
  <path d='M42 46 Q50 40 58 46 Q56 55 50 57 Q44 55 42 46 Z' fill='#ff6f7d'/>
  <path d='M44 47 Q50 43 55 47' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3ba' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cucumber -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='54' r='4' fill='#6fd36f'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='54' r='2' fill='#b6f0b6'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff2a8'>
    <path d='M16 22 L18.5 28 L24.5 30.5 L18.5 33 L16 39 L13.5 33 L7.5 30.5 L13.5 28 Z'/>
    <path d='M84 18 L86 23 L91 25 L86 27 L84 32 L82 27 L77 25 L82 23 Z'/>
    <path d='M86 58 L87.5 61.5 L91 63 L87.5 64.5 L86 68 L84.5 64.5 L81 63 L84.5 61.5 Z'/>
    <path d='M13 56 L14.5 59.5 L18 61 L14.5 62.5 L13 66 L11.5 62.5 L8 61 L11.5 59.5 Z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- small sparkle dots -->
  <g fill='#ffe27a'>
    <circle cx='26' cy='16' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='74' cy='84' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='40' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='40' r='1.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
